facts.fact: Government Notice No. 189 in Government Gazette No. 7308 publishes the National Broadband Policy, which the Minister of Information and Communication Technology, Dr P. Mushelenga, signed on 27 July 2020 and issued to the Communications Regulatory Authority of Namibia as policy guidelines under section 7 of the Communications Act 2009; the gazette is dated 14 August 2020.

note: The captured text is truncated before the objectives, financing and monitoring sections, so it states nothing on money committed or progress reported; the table of contents lists an implementation action plan for 2019-2024 as Appendix 6, but its text is not in the capture.

facts.fact: The article says the National Digital Strategy launched in 2025, with the Sixth National Development Plan, charts digital infrastructure through 2025/26 to 2029/30, with a target of raising internet use from 53% to 90% by 2030; the period had not ended and no successor is named.

note: Only the standing fact: no money or progress against the strategy's targets is tied to it. The Digital Government Strategic Roadmap 2024-2026 is not a broadband plan.
A proposed ministerial policy directive on minimum broadband speed out for comment; a directive is not a national broadband plan, and the annexure is not in the capture.
Reports a N$40m PowerCom tower project and a 50% to 90% internet penetration target by 2030 under NDP6; the article names no broadband plan, and the money is not tied to one.
